config.used_reason: skill-factory uses the Mise task graph, pinned native toolchains, a minimum runner contract, bounded parallel jobs, a fixed task root, and explicit environment values to produce portable agent skill packages.
config.nonuse_reason: The remaining top-level Mise features do not improve this single-package agent skill factory result, or they introduce remote services, secrets, shell state, repository scale, or side effects that this invocation does not own. Dotfile history is outside agent skill package maintenance; Git lineage and invocation receipts already own change evidence.
config.creative_use: The agent skill environment disables bytecode files and uses dependency download caches while package checks rerun against their current owned inputs.
config.evidence: mise.toml, generated mise template, speed-contract tests, and plan-standardize runtime-cache tests.

task.used_reason: skill-factory uses explicit task metadata, dependency edges, bounded execution, native tools, argument contracts, platform commands, and prefixed evidence for agent skill operations.
task.nonuse_reason: This agent skill package has no proved complete result-cache key. Freshness skips and artifact caching therefore remain unused. Other unused fields lack a demonstrated operation-specific need; this disposition does not forbid justified target-specific use.
task.creative_use: Agent skill package checks rerun even after a prior pass so newly discovered files and changed checker dependencies cannot inherit stale acceptance; timeouts bound stalls and a post dependency checks primitives after runner maintenance.
task.evidence: mise.toml, generated mise template, test_native_task_cache.py repeated-run rejection, speed-contract tests, and task graph tests.

task_config.used_reason: skill-factory fixes every agent skill task to the package root so invocation location cannot change file ownership.
task_config.nonuse_reason: The agent skill factory has one task file, no descendant config scope, no safe artifact-cache outputs, no Rust cache, and no need to override the host shell or ambient environment inheritance.
task_config.creative_use: A single agent skill config-root directory rule removes repeated task paths and prevents accidental reads outside the package.
task_config.evidence: mise.toml task_config and invocation tests from a non-root working directory.

tool.used_reason: skill-factory declares Python and uv versions for deterministic agent skill checks and cached dependency resolution.
tool.nonuse_reason: The Python registry already supplies stable ordering and portable artifacts, so source refs, local paths, prefixes, install ordering, release-age delay, and operating-system filters add no skill-factory value.
tool.creative_use: The agent skill graph lets uv cache one pinned YAML parser while every validation run receives the same dependency.
tool.evidence: mise.toml tool declarations, malformed-frontmatter attack, and doctor version receipts.
